## Summary

Describe what changed and why it improves LAGSHIFT.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `python -m unittest discover -s tests -q`.
- [ ] I tested the affected Windows workflow when applicable.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, public IP addresses, private endpoints,
      diagnostic archives, generated builds, or user network state.
- [ ] Network changes remain reversible and fail closed.
- [ ] This change preserves the public-edition boundary: no imported tunnel
      configurations, subscriptions, or general-purpose VPN surface.

## User-visible impact

List any UI, privacy, security, installer, or compatibility impact. Write
`None` when the change is internal only.

## Screenshots or logs

Attach sanitized evidence when useful. Remove usernames, tokens, IP addresses,
private links, and unrelated application data first.
